story: A typhoon warning cancelled my flight. I paid for one night in a hotel. Receipt attached.
My checked bag never arrived. The airline's loss report and receipts are attached.
Food poisoning on day two. The doctor's invoice is attached.
The airline had an engine fault and my flight was nine hours late. Meal receipts attached.
My bag was stolen from a cafe table while I went to the toilet.
My flight was two hours late. I bought lunch.
My flight was cancelled by an official typhoon warning and I paid for a hotel.
I broke my wrist while hiking. The hospital bill is attached.
My suitcase with clothes and a camera was lost. The loss report is attached.
I had an asthma attack on the trip. I have had asthma for ten years and did not declare it. Doctor's invoice attached.
My flight was delayed eight hours by an engine fault. Meal and taxi receipts attached.
My two-year-old bag was destroyed. It cost S$400 when new.
My flight on 11 March was cancelled by a baggage handlers' strike that was announced on 3 March. I bought my policy on 5 March.
I needed an appendix operation abroad. The hospital invoice is attached.
My flight was seven hours late. Receipts for meals and a hotel room attached.
I left my laptop bag on a bench at the station and it was gone.

My flight was cancelled. I paid for a hotel.
This is the third bag I have lost this year. The report is attached.
My bag was lost on the way home. The loss report is attached.

My flight was cancelled. The airline already gave me a hotel but I want to claim for my own hotel too.
I had a bad toothache and saw an emergency dentist. The invoice is attached.
